slides.title: Shared Treasury for Open Source Communities
slides.en: Hello Professor and everyone. Our project is a shared treasury for a small open source community. Three designated managers control one pool of ether. Every payment needs two different managers to approve it before an execution transaction can release the funds.
slides.zh: 老师、同学们好。我们的项目是一个面向小型开源社区的共同资金管理系统。三名指定负责人管理一个以太币资金池，每笔付款都需要两名不同负责人批准，之后才能通过执行交易释放资金。
slides.action: Show the title and the two-of-three policy.

slides.title: A shared approval rule for community expenses
slides.en: The users are small teams that want to receive contributions, reward contributors, and review spending. Managers decide whether an expense is appropriate. Supporters can add funds, while members can inspect the records. The contract enforces the agreed approval rule; the community remains responsible for the decision itself.
slides.zh: 目标用户是希望接收支持款、奖励贡献者并查看开支的小型团队。负责人判断支出是否合理，支持者可以存入资金，成员可以查看记录。合约执行约定的审批规则，而支出决定本身仍由社区负责。
slides.action: Point to the roles and the three example use cases.

slides.title: An established pattern with a deliberately small scope
slides.en: We use an established multisignature idea. Safe is a much more mature solution with broader management and execution features. Our course prototype keeps three owners and the threshold fixed so that we can inspect the complete workflow. A conventional approval website remains a reasonable alternative when users already trust its operator and use bank payments.
slides.zh: 我们采用已有的多签思想。Safe 是更成熟的方案，支持更广泛的管理和执行功能。课程原型固定三名负责人和审批门槛，方便检查完整流程。如果用户已经信任平台管理者并使用银行付款，普通审批网站仍然是合理选择。
slides.action: Use the comparison table; do not claim that this project invents multisignature wallets.

slides.title: The contract is the authorization boundary
slides.en: The webpage connects through a provider to the Solidity contract. The contract stores owners, payment details, approval records, and execution state. Purpose text stays in browser storage, while its hash is recorded on chain. We check that hash before displaying a description as verified. The browser sandbox runs a real local EVM with demonstration funds; wallet mode connects to a separately deployed contract.
slides.zh: 网页通过 Provider 连接 Solidity 合约。合约保存负责人、付款信息、批准记录和执行状态。用途文本保存在浏览器中，其哈希值写入链上；显示为已验证说明前会检查哈希。浏览器沙盒运行真实的本地 EVM，使用演示资金；钱包模式则连接另行部署的合约。
slides.action: Explain the on-chain and off-chain components, then point to the two connection modes.

slides.title: Approval and execution are separate operations
slides.en: Submitting a request does not count as approval. Each owner can confirm once and can revoke before payment. After two current approvals, any owner may execute the request if the treasury has enough funds. A successful request can pay only once. Pending requests do not reserve money, so balance is checked again when execution happens.
slides.zh: 提交申请不等于批准。每名负责人只能计入一次批准，并可在付款前撤销。获得两份当前有效的批准后，只要余额充足，任意负责人都可以执行付款。成功执行的申请不能再次付款。待执行申请不预留资金，因此执行时会重新检查余额。
slides.action: Trace the state diagram and the revocation path.

slides.title: Execution checks precede the recipient call
slides.en: The execution function checks ownership, pending state, approval count, and available balance. It marks the request as executed before calling the recipient, and a guard blocks nested execution. If the recipient rejects the transfer, the transaction reverts and restores the earlier state. The source code and tests make these decisions inspectable.
slides.zh: 执行函数检查负责人权限、待执行状态、批准数量和可用余额。它先标记已执行，再调用收款方，并用防重入保护阻止嵌套执行。如果收款方拒绝转账，交易回滚并恢复之前的状态。源代码和测试使这些设计可以被检查。
slides.action: Show the actual executeTransaction source excerpt. Explain that the checks are in the contract, not only the page.

slides.title: Live demonstration of a contributor payment
slides.en: I will now launch the sandbox. This balance is demonstration ether with no monetary value. Manager A submits a payment request for documentation work. Notice that the request starts with no approvals. Manager A confirms, but one approval is still insufficient. I switch to Manager B and confirm the same request. Payment is now eligible, but it has not happened yet. I execute it and show the confirmed receipt, the updated balance, and the paid status. The completed request cannot be paid again.
slides.zh: 现在启动沙盒。这里的余额是没有真实价值的演示以太币。负责人 A 为文档工作提交付款申请，请注意申请最初没有批准。A 批准后仍不足以付款。我切换到负责人 B，批准同一申请。现在可以执行付款，但资金尚未转出。执行后展示确认回执、更新后的余额和已付款状态。这个已完成的申请不能再次付款。
slides.action: Launch sandbox. Use the prefilled recipient, 0.25 ETH and purpose Documentation contribution. Submit as Manager A, confirm as A, inspect disabled Execute, switch to Manager B, confirm, then execute. Show receipt and Paid filter. Do not reload during the demo.

slides.title: Recorded tests exercise the spending policy
slides.en: Our recorded local contract run passed 29 tests. These include invalid owners, unauthorized actions, duplicate approvals, insufficient approvals, insufficient funds, revocation, and repeated execution. Receiver contracts also test rejected transfers and attempts to reenter the same or another approved request. These checks support the tested cases; they are not an independent security audit.
slides.zh: 实际记录的本地合约运行通过了 29 项测试，包括无效负责人、越权操作、重复批准、批准不足、余额不足、撤销和重复执行。收款合约还测试了拒绝转账，以及重入同一申请或另一已批准申请的情况。这些检查支持已测试场景，并不等于独立安全审计。
slides.action: Show the test evidence and point out the local environment.

slides.title: Gas observations from one local lifecycle
slides.en: We also saved gas used by the mined transactions. For this single local run, request submission used 142,609 gas and execution used 70,600 gas. These numbers describe the measured configuration. They are not currency prices or a throughput benchmark, and they should not be treated as fixed public-network costs.
slides.zh: 我们还保存了已出块交易的 Gas 用量。在这一次本地运行中，提交申请使用 142609 Gas，执行付款使用 70600 Gas。这些数字描述的是本次测量配置，不是货币价格或吞吐量测试，也不应当被当作固定的公网成本。
slides.action: Use the native chart. Explain units and single-run scope.

slides.title: Deployment evidence has separate boundaries
slides.en: The browser sandbox, the website host, and a public blockchain deployment are different things. The current evidence records the local contract tests and the tested application workflow. A hosted website alone does not prove a contract is deployed on Ethereum mainnet or on the course's required cloud blockchain platforms. Those deployment targets still need confirmation.
slides.zh: 浏览器沙盒、网站托管和公共区块链部署是不同的事情。当前证据记录了本地合约测试和已检查的应用流程。仅有托管网站不能证明合约已部署到以太坊主网或课程要求的云区块链平台，这些部署目标仍需确认。
slides.action: Show the deployment status table; use only verified URLs and receipts.

slides.title: Governance and recovery remain human responsibilities
slides.en: There are clear limits. Two owners can approve an inappropriate expense, and losing two keys can block spending because owners are fixed. A description hash cannot recover missing text or prove that work was completed. Future work should address recovery and shared description availability, and compare those additions with a mature solution such as Safe before expanding the contract.
slides.zh: 系统的局限很明确。两名负责人仍可能批准不合理开支；由于负责人固定，丢失两把密钥可能使资金无法支出。说明哈希不能恢复丢失文本，也不能证明工作已经完成。后续应解决恢复机制和说明共享问题，并在扩展合约前与 Safe 等成熟方案比较。
slides.action: Discuss the limits calmly, then identify the next course steps.

slides.title: A reproducible prototype with an explicit scope
slides.en: The project delivers a complete local approval-and-payment workflow, readable contract code, a web interface, and reproducible test records. Our main result is the integration of an established pattern within a controlled scope. The report and repository contain the implementation details and references. Thank you; we welcome your feedback on the deployment requirements and project scope.
slides.zh: 本项目交付了完整的本地审批付款流程、可阅读的合约代码、网页界面和可复现的测试记录。主要成果是在可控范围内整合已有模式，报告和仓库中提供实现细节与参考资料。谢谢，欢迎老师对部署要求和项目范围提出建议。
slides.action: Show the repository link and remaining course decisions.
